In England, there's a bench that means: please talk to me.
In twenty-nineteen, police in a seaside town put a sign on it.
It says: sit here if you don't mind someone stopping to say hello.
The idea spread across Europe, Australia and North America.
But not everyone has a bench nearby.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny is always happy to chat.
